adapter_hint: Wikidata population, capital and coordinates for every country: python scripts/fetch_wikidata.py --level admin2 --countries ARM
population_note: Armstat's permanent population on 1 January 2026, recalculated on the base of the 2022 census. Yerevan is a marz and a city at once, which the map draws at both levels; this is the city's own row.
median_age_note: Interpolated within the age group holding the middle person (under one, 1-4, then five-year groups to 85 and over): Armstat publishes nothing finer by marz. Yerevan is a marz and a city at once, which the map draws at both levels; this is the city's own row.
sex_ratio_note: 517,001 men and 630,663 women. Yerevan is a marz and a city at once, which the map draws at both levels; this is the city's own row.
ethnicity_note: Nationality (ազգություն) as each person stated it, 2011 census, the permanent population. The 2022 census has published no table by marz yet. Table 5.2-1 names only the nationalities numerous in the marz -- here Armenian, Russian, Yazidi, Ukrainian, Persian, Greek, Georgian, Assyrian -- and counts every other in 'Other' (1,075 people), so a group absent here may still live in the marz. Yerevan is a marz and a city at once, which the map draws at both levels; this is the city's own row.
language_note: Mother tongue (մայրենի լեզու), 2011 census, the permanent population; 'Ezidian' is the Yezidi tongue the census names apart from Kurdish. Yerevan is a marz and a city at once, which the map draws at both levels; this is the city's own row.
religion_note: Religious belief (կրոնական դավանանք), 2011 census, the permanent population; 'Yazidi' is the census's Sharfadin. 'Not stated' joins those who refused to answer and those whose belief was not recorded. Yerevan is a marz and a city at once, which the map draws at both levels; this is the city's own row.
